title.narrative: Enhanced capacity of constituents to implement policies and programmes on industry, infrastructure and skill development to achieve decent employment and inclusive labour market institutions

description.narrative: Ethiopia’s development has been driven by public investment-funded construction, and FDI-fuelled, export-oriented, agriculture and manufacturing. Vast fertile agricultural land, and a large workforce with very low reservation wages, are its key ingredients, within a political and security context that is considered broadly favourable. Rural Ethiopia is densely populated. Fairly high rates of agricultural growth have been observed, but these had only marginal effects on rural incomes: rural growth is happening in niches. Methods to increase agricultural productivity and also ensure value addition to the Agro products more widely will be needed for rural incomes to rise. But such a policy will invariably drive increasing numbers of people out of the countryside (due to, for instance, mechanization, aggregation of plots). This is already happening: internal migration is mainly necessity driven. The result is a labour force that remains poor and unproductive as it transitions from subsistence agriculture to subsistence urban activity. Manufacturing growth (in employment intensive subsectors) needs thus be the priority, including by building linkages between agriculture and other sectors of the economy. Agro-food and other processing of agricultural products come to have been prioritized by the GOE wherein Agro processing is positioned as a priority sector in the National development plans. The main objective of the CPO ETH127 is to support Ministry of Labour and Skills (MOLS) reform and run an integrated employment services agenda with the involvement of skills development within the employment services. The regional Employment services in Amhara region and the Youth Employability Services Centre set up in Bahir Dar, Amhara has been playing active role in addressing the skills gab and facilitate the smooth school to work transition.
